modelingNotes: Washington Square Arch — procedural, CC0-1.0, no textures or source mesh. bun generators/washington-square-arch.ts

Map frame: x = east along the arch's long axis, y = north up Fifth Avenue, z up, metres. Placed at bearing 32°. The OSM envelope is 19.1 × 7.0 m and the real height 23.5 m; the opening is the real 30 × 47 ft (9.0 × 14.3 m).

Styled to STYLE.md: warm ivory marble, bevelled edges, one bold archivolt, paneled piers, broad spandrel reliefs, an entablature and an attic with recessed panels. The two Washington statues stand at the foot of the north face as chunky mirrored forms. Everything is mirrored about both axes (the statues about x only) and stays inside the 19.1 × 7.0 outline.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "washington-square-arch", model "washington-square-arch"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/washington-square-arch.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
